`@osterman` Some short identifiers are aliases, but these Sonnet 4.6 identifiers are valid model IDs in their own right:

- Anthropic documents `claude-sonnet-4-6` without a date suffix.
- AWS documents [`anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-sonnet-4-6.html) without a date or `-v1:0` suffix.
- `anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0` identifies **Sonnet 4.5**, not a longer form of the Sonnet 4.6 ID.

My earlier guidance should have separated **valid model identifiers** from **Atmos defaults**. This replacement aligns the documented default with the provider constant. It does not correct an invalid Sonnet 4.6 identifier. Explicit Sonnet 4.6 examples can remain unchanged.
